model.note: Part outlines are traced from Redexim's studio image and are approximate. The gearbox internals, crankshaft, tine elements and draw rods sit under the covers and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from Redexim parts manual 2440 and user manual 2434 (2022 issue); the 2018 unit (Verti Drain 1) should be checked against its plate for gearbox differences. Small Verti-Drain 1 (7007) shares this record but is a different machine: see its entry.

hood.name: Top and rear covers
hood.desc: Perforated covers over the crankshaft, draw rods and tine elements. Before each use do a 5 minute run-up and look and listen through the covers for anything loose. Look closely at the draw rods, crank bearings and tine holders at the first 20 h and every 100 h. Clean soil off after use.

sidepanel.name: Side plates and frame ends
sidepanel.desc: End plates carrying the model and safety decals. Check all bolts and nuts at the first 20 h (new or after repair) and every 100 h: re-torque, and Loctite any that keep loosening. Rollers must turn freely with no loose bolts or nuts.

frame.name: Main frame
frame.desc: Keep the machine level and at 90 deg to the ground when working. A machine not at 90 deg (or worn bearing bushes, or reversing with the tines near the ground) bends the draw rods. A machine not level, or PTO joints not in line or at unequal angles, causes vibration that works the crankshaft big-end nuts loose. Bolt and nut check at the first 20 h and every 100 h.

headstock.name: Three-point headstock (Cat 1)
headstock.desc: Cat 1 three-point linkage (the old Notion list had Cat 2: wrong). Minimum tractor about 25 hp with 700 kg lift. No hydraulics and no transport wheels on the 7215: it runs on the front and rear rollers. Bottom link pins 2490881, top link pin 2490825 (parts manual 2440).

linkpins.name: Link pins (Cat 1)
linkpins.desc: Bottom link pins 2490881 and top link pin 2490825 (parts manual 2440). The 7215 is Cat 1.

pto.name: PTO shaft and slip clutch (Benzi T-40)
pto.desc: Benzi T-40 shaft with a friction slip clutch on the machine side: there is no shear bolt (the old Notion 'shear bolt, keep 20+' row is wrong). Shaft 611.405.100 (tl 510) or 611.409.100 (tl 910), cut to suit the tractor (manual 4.1): tube overlap at least 250 mm, joint angles under 30 deg, both joints in line. Run 400 rpm PTO (500 rpm max): heavy tines at high rpm make the tine holders float and hit the rear roller. Grease 4 shots EP2 at the first 20 h, then every 100 h. Check the PTO slip-clutch lock bolt at the gearbox every 40 h: 80 Nm. Slip clutch monthly in season: check it slips and grips, clean inside, replace the lining rings (BEN F030/S, 2 per clutch) if worn or if it slips often. Clutch setting: the tech spec says 400 Nm max, the Benzi page gives 450 Nm at 28 mm spring length 'for information only, use a test rig': have the dealer set it on a rig. Guard undamaged and chained before each use; keep spare PTO-cover chains (workshop note Jul 2025).

gearbox.name: Gearbox
gearbox.desc: SAE 80W90 gear oil, 3 L. Drain and refill every 500 h (the old Notion 'SAE 90 EP, 200 h' is wrong). At 10 to 30 h a year these units will not reach 500 h for years: check level, leaks and condition yearly and change every 3 years or if milky or dirty (best practice, not in the manual). Check for leaks at the two crank-side oil seals (63x100x12, 4409160, 2 per gearbox) and the input seal (4406420). Seal change by manual procedure 14.2.1: fill the space between seal and bearing with NLGI 2-3 bearing grease and use Loctite 5970 on the splines. Bearings (2 of each): 6207 711.350.170, 32208 4810470, 6305 4816750, 6309-2RS 713.450.250. The 2022 parts manual shows gearwheel differences between serial prefixes A and H: check the plate on the 2018 unit.

crank.name: Crankshaft and crank bearings
crank.desc: Crank bearings 6013-LLU, 713.650.180, 6 per machine; big-end bearings 6006-LLU, 713.300.130. LLU is NTN's 2RS contact seal, so any 2RS bearing of the same size fits (6013-2RS is 65x100x18). Yearly: turn the crankshaft by hand and feel for tight spots or rumble. Big-end nuts working loose means a vibration problem or a collapsed crank bearing: fix the vibration first (machine not level, PTO joints not in line or at unequal angles), then replace the crank or bearing promptly (manual 14.2.2). After any crank repair the shaft can run tight: tap the cranks to relieve the tension (14.2.3) and realign the elements (14.3); pre-tension shortens bearing life. The 7215 has no cam follower (old Notion row).

elements.name: Tine elements, holders and draw rods
elements.desc: One tine holder per element (492.521.730). 8 draw rods (complete draw rod 490.344.152), each with 2 draw-rod bearings 6005-LLU (713.250.120). Element bearings 6202-LLU, 713.150.110 (qty 12 on element parts page 04-1). Draw rods bend if the machine is not at 90 deg, the bearing bushes are worn, or you reverse with the tines near the ground. Yearly: check draw rods, rubber stops and element alignment. For long storage do not leave the tine holders folded up against the stops: it shortens shock-absorber spring life.

tines.name: Tines and lock bolts
tines.desc: Tine holders take 3 x 12 mm and 2 x 18 mm holes. Standard set 24 x 12 mm (2381837, 12 x 250; 65 mm side spacing) or 16 x 18 mm (2381841, 18 x 250; 100 mm side spacing). Max solid 18 x 250, max hollow 25 x 250, max depth 250 mm: never fit longer or thicker (the 300 mm solids and 2382638 are for bigger Verti-Drains). Before each use: all tines the same length and size, none bent; replace a bent tine straight away (the machine goes unstable). Lock bolts M10 (4001675, M10x35; parts manual also lists M10x40 812.100.401), 40 Nm max; if a tine still slips grind a small flat on the shank. Solids: point to the front roller (to the rear on weak turf), angle 75 to 90 deg, rear roller unlocked. Hollows: angle 90 deg, side outlet to the rear; break hard ground with solids first. Bending or breaking means the ground is too hard or dry: irrigate first, use shorter or thinner tines. The depth decal reads true only with 250 mm tines: deduct the difference for shorter or worn tines. Keep matched lengths in a set; worn-short tines can do shallower work. Needle tines: adapter block 9990206 (8 per set) with 8 x 150 solids 311.108.150; mini-needle block 314.425.170 (8 per set) with 168 x 311.105.125. Turf hold-down kits 211.721.002 (12 mm) / 211.721.004 (18 mm) are finger kits that stop turf lifting, not tines: fingers 311.506.186 / 311.506.188, fitted to the pre-mounted beam. Count stock yearly (16 x 18 mm or 24 x 12 mm per set, plus lock bolts).

rollerF.name: Front roller
rollerF.desc: Grease the roller bearings 4 shots EP2 at the first 20 h, then every 100 h. Roller bearings UCFL 204D1, 742.200.330, 2 per roller. Check the roller turns freely. Roller part 488.159.131 (parts manual 2440, front and rear rollers). Working depth is set at this roller by manual spindles: see Depth adjustment.

rollerR.name: Rear roller and scraper
rollerR.desc: Unlock the rear roller for solid tines; it may be lifted and locked for hollow coring. Rear roller scraper 468.049.162 (1 per machine): keep it in place. Bearings UCFL 204D1, 742.200.330, 2 per roller: grease 4 shots EP2 at the first 20 h, then every 100 h. Tine holders floating at high PTO rpm hit this roller: run 400 rpm.

depth.name: Depth adjustment
depth.desc: Depth is set by manual spindles on the front roller (2692101): the 7215 has no hydraulics. Set both sides evenly: never more than 4 turns on one side before evening up. Every 100 h: grease the front roller depth spindles, clean the spindles and nuts and spray them with anti-stick grease oil. The depth decal reads true only with 250 mm tines: deduct the difference for shorter or worn tines.

grease.name: Grease points and lubricants
grease.desc: EP2 grease: PTO shaft and front and rear rollers 4 shots each at the first 20 h, then every 100 h; front roller depth spindles every 100 h. Extra greasing does no harm but the OEM interval is 100 h. Gearbox: SAE 80W90, 3 L. No telematics: hours from the tractor or job records.

vd7007.name: Small Verti-Drain 1 (Verti-Drain 7007, disabled)
vd7007.desc: Shares this record but is a different machine: self-propelled walk-behind, 13 hp electric-start engine (Honda: see the Honda parts manual on the Redexim site), 675 mm width, 150 mm depth. If returned to service: first 20 h grease the roller bearing (4 shots EP2), check bolts, renew engine oil; every 100 h grease the roller and front roller spindles, renew engine oil, grease the rear-wheel chain drive, check bolts; every 500 h renew hydraulic oil (7 L, 10W40). Gearbox lifetime-greased (EP 00). Max tine 12 x 150 solid or 19 x 150 hollow; standard 8 x 150 solids with adapters. Source: 7007 manual 0948 sec 1.0 and 10.0.

2490881.name: Bottom link pin, Cat 1
2490881.note: Parts manual 2440. Order through Nuturf (Redexim AU distributor).

490.344.152.name: Draw rod, complete
490.344.152.note: 8 per machine; each takes 2 x 6005-LLU bearings (713.250.120).

488.159.131.name: Roller (front and rear rollers)
488.159.131.note: Listed in the bible against the rollers from parts manual 2440: check front or rear on the parts page before ordering.

2692101.name: Depth spindle (front roller)
2692101.note: Manual depth adjustment; the 7215 has no hydraulics.

812.100.401.name: Tine lock bolt M10x40
812.100.401.note: Also listed in parts manual 2440 (qty 50 per set on the tine page). 40 Nm max.

311.108.150.name: Needle tine 8 x 150 solid
311.108.150.note: For adapter block 9990206 (6 tines per block). Nuturf $3.30 inc GST each (Oct 2026).

311.105.125.name: Mini-needle tine 5 mm
311.105.125.note: 168 per set in mini-needle blocks 314.425.170. Nuturf $1.43 inc GST each (Oct 2026).
